limitations: API equivalent only; not actual bill or subscription usage.
Subject counts include all invalid audit phases, repairs and fresh re-audits; setup, outer orchestration, postgrading/publication outside subject counts are not free.
Conditions overlap and other account activity exists; ordered matched pair does not support causal speed or subscription savings claims.
Calendar elapsed includes interruption gaps; active controller elapsed is accumulated wall interval, not CPU time.
checks: Native CLI increment or cumulative counters reconciled against exact snapshot prefix; resume baselines match prior owned snapshot.
Explicit native metadata ancestry only; each root cumulative counter counted once plus each descendant once.
Model/effort taken from native turn context; spawn declarations sanitized.
Decimal costs independently recomputed; cached tokens subset input, reasoning subset output.
Same-day official price recheck agrees with frozen rates for actual observed models.
controlled_conclusions: Observed native model and effort are measured separately from model-routing declarations.
All retained invalid audit attempts and repair/revalidation phases remain included in subject accounting.
Single long-context requests first appear in its builder repair/revalidation resume; context-growth mechanism remains a hypothesis.
Input totals include cached input and output totals include reasoning; subset counters are not added again.
Per-request mixed-tier estimate uses reported request input, strict frozen 272000 threshold, and same-day verified rates.
